question: If cos B = 5 over 7 , what is the value of cosec B + cot B? Given that 0 (pi )/(2)?
solution:
**Given data:**

cos B = 5 over 7 

**Concept:**

In a right-angled triangle ABC, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e8a276c5607a5e51b77f19a997e9430c5ce95d62d9f8f978dd239e09376fa32.png] 

cos θ = bover h 

b² + p² = h² (From Pythagora's theorem)

**Calculation:**

we know that cos B = 5 over 7 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63f477b93e2eb1572c250f4a7141593a3d3826e7a819710fea88af455bace17e.png] 

AC² = AB² + BC²

⇒ 7² = AB² + 5²

⇒ AB = √(49 - 25)

⇒ AB = 2√6 cm 

cosec B + cot B

⇒ (AC/AB) + (BC/AB)

⇒ 7over 2√6 + 5over 2√6 = 12over 2√6 = √6

∴ **The value of cosec B + cot B is √6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** The side opposite to the angle is the perpendicular. Hence, from ∠ACB, AB is the perpendicular and BC is the base. Similarly, for ∠CAB, BC is the perpendicular, and AB is the base. 

7d:T
